title: koeleria koidzumiana
intro: Koeleria koidzumiana, commonly known as the Japanese June grass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Koeleria koidzumiana include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
